entities.summary: The Polissia National University, known as the Zhytomyr National Agroecological University prior to 2020, is a public university in Zhytomyr, Ukraine. The university provides specialists in the majority of national economic sectors in the Ukrainian Polesia. The university has some seven thousand students and is divided into eight faculties and 42 departments.
